short.name: Adversarial Replay Sandbox
short.desc: Isolated replay environment that re-executes suspicious sessions server-side to confirm cheating without client intervention — eliminates false positives on edge cases

short.name: Input Entropy Fingerprinting
short.desc: Measures Shannon entropy of raw input streams to detect synthetic inputs — human input has natural entropy patterns that no cheat can replicate

short.name: Zero-Footprint Mode
short.desc: Kernel module unloads completely between scan cycles — leaves zero memory residue, making Cerberus undetectable by cheat developers during reverse engineering

short.name: Cross-Session Behavioral Graph
short.desc: Graph neural network that builds player identity from behavioral patterns across sessions — detects ban evaders even with new hardware and accounts

mid.name: Proof-of-Play Protocol
mid.desc: Cryptographic attestation that a game session was played legitimately — players can prove clean sessions to tournament organizers without revealing system state

mid.name: Peripheral Bus Sniffer
mid.desc: Monitors USB/HID bus traffic patterns to detect hardware cheat devices (Cronus, XIM, strikepack) by analyzing input timing jitter and polling anomalies

mid.name: Silent Honeypot Injection
mid.desc: Injects fake memory regions that appear to contain game state — any cheat reading them triggers instant detection without false positives, since no legitimate process accesses them

mid.name: Neural Style Transfer Detection
mid.desc: Detects AI-powered aimbots that mimic human aim patterns by analyzing micro-corrections and acceleration curves that neural networks cannot perfectly replicate

mid.name: Cheat Provider Lifecycle Tracker
mid.desc: Automated dark web monitoring that tracks cheat providers from release to takedown — predicts new bypass attempts before they ship based on provider development patterns

long.name: Cognitive Load Analysis
long.desc: Measures player cognitive load through input complexity and reaction timing — cheaters exhibit unnaturally low cognitive load during high-complexity situations

long.name: Federated Detection Mesh
long.desc: Cross-title threat intelligence sharing using differential privacy — multiple game studios contribute to a shared detection model without exposing any individual game's data

long.name: Hardware Execution Tracing
long.desc: Uses Intel PT (Processor Trace) to record actual CPU instruction flow during game execution — detects code injection at the hardware level, impossible to spoof from software

long.name: Temporal Anomaly Detection
long.desc: Analyzes time-series game state deltas at microsecond resolution — detects speedhacks, teleports, and physics exploits that modify game time without triggering traditional checks

completed.name: DMA Board Detection
completed.desc: PCIe device fingerprinting for DMA-based cheats — first AC to detect Screamer and custom DMA boards via firmware timing analysis

completed.name: Behavioral AI v7
completed.desc: 7th generation behavioral analysis neural network trained on 50K labeled cheat samples

completed.name: Multi-Region Deployment
completed.desc: 9-region global infrastructure with sub-50ms signature sync latency

templatePool.name: Retinal Scan Correlation
templatePool.desc: Eye tracking data analysis to detect ESP/wallhack users by correlating gaze patterns with enemy positions behind walls

templatePool.name: Physics Simulation Validator
templatePool.desc: Server-side physics replay that detects impossible movement trajectories and collision bypasses

templatePool.name: Binary Birthmarking
templatePool.desc: Unique per-client code mutations that make each game binary identifiable — leaked cheats can be traced to the exact account that extracted them

templatePool.name: Audio Fingerprint Scanner
templatePool.desc: Detects audio-based ESP tools by analyzing whether player reactions correlate with sound cues that should be inaudible at their position

templatePool.name: GPU Shader Integrity Monitor
templatePool.desc: Validates GPU shader programs at runtime to detect wallhack shaders and chams injected via graphics driver hooks

templatePool.name: Network Packet Entropy Analysis
templatePool.desc: Detects packet manipulation and lag switches by analyzing entropy patterns in outbound network traffic

templatePool.name: Autonomous Red Team Agent
templatePool.desc: AI agent that continuously attempts to bypass Cerberus detection — finds vulnerabilities before cheat developers do

templatePool.name: Social Graph Cheater Detection
templatePool.desc: Maps player social connections to identify boosting rings and organized cheating groups through behavioral clustering

templatePool.name: Memory Page Fault Canary
templatePool.desc: Places watchpoint-free memory canaries using page table manipulation — detects memory reads without any CPU overhead

templatePool.name: Competitive Integrity Score
templatePool.desc: Public per-player trust score based on behavioral history that tournament organizers and matchmaking can use

templatePool.name: Polymorphic Driver Loader
templatePool.desc: Each client loads a uniquely obfuscated kernel driver variant — prevents universal bypass development

templatePool.name: Inference-on-Edge via NPU
templatePool.desc: Offload behavioral AI inference to dedicated NPU hardware for zero-impact scanning during gameplay

templatePool.name: Multi-Language SDK
templatePool.desc: SDK bindings for C#, Rust, Go, and Python alongside native C++
